title: Bitamummaa Guddaa Abbaa Biyyummaa
intro: Biyya dinqii durii fi mul’ata gadi fagoo keessa of argatta. Bulchaan humna guddaa qabu tokko, waamicha hin eegamne isa mudate, imala adeemsa hiree ishee fi amantii saba ishee jijjiirutti seene. Eenyummaa nama guddaa kanaa saaxiluu dandeessaa?
clues: Mootummaa badhaadhina qabu, qabeenya guddaa fi teessoo ulfina qabeessa taʼeen faayame irrattin bulchaa ture.
Aniifi sabni koo qaama samii tokko gooftaa keenya ta’uu isaa amanuudhaan, onnee koo keessatti shakkii qabadheera ta’us, waaqeffanna turre.
Ergamaan addaa, simbirroon, anaa fi sabni koo Waaqa Tokkicha jalatti akka bitamnuuf xalayaa naaf geessite.
Ergaa kanaan dura hin argamne kanaaf akkamitti deebii akkan kennu gorsitoota koo humna guddaa qaban mariisiseera.
Humnaa fi akeeka isaa madaaluuf abdadheen nama xalayaa sana ergeef kennaa gatii guddaa qabu erguuf murteesse.
Yeroon achi gahu masaraa mootummaan lafti isaa feesbuukii irraa hojjetame, akka bishaan kuufamaa ta’ee mul’atu na ajaa’ibe, yeroo sanatti ture Gooftaa uumama hundumaaf bitamuu koo kan labse.

trial.label: Yaali/Taatee
options: Imala Nabi Suleymaan waliin wal arguuf godhame
trial.answer: Imala Nabi Suleymaan waliin wal arguuf godhame

arabic: إِنِّى وَجَدتُّ ٱمْرَأَةًۭ تَمْلِكُهُمْ وَأُوتِيَتْ مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَلَهَا عَرْشٌ عَظِيمٌۭ
verse: Indeed, I found a woman ruling them and she has been given of every thing and for her (is) a throne great (23) (27:23)
